new_candidates.body:
**Version:** LeRobot 0.6.1, `--env.type=libero --env.task=libero_10`, Tesla T4, EGL, seed 1000.

**What happens.** `LiberoEnv` renders 360 x 360 images by default (`observation_height` / `observation_width`). The SmolVLA LIBERO checkpoints declare 3 x 256 x 256 camera inputs (`input_features` in the checkpoint config). Running them with the default size gives a much lower success rate than running them at 256, with nothing in the log pointing to the mismatch.

**Measured** (LIBERO-10 tasks 0 and 4, 10 episodes each, same initial states and seed, `policy.n_action_steps=10`):

| Checkpoint | Obs size | Tool | Task 0 | Task 4 | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero | 256 (`--env.observation_height=256 --env.observation_width=256`) | stock `lerobot-eval` | 4/10 | 2/10 | 6/20 |
| HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero | 360 (default) | a wrapper around LeRobot's own `make_env` and processors | 0/10 | 0/10 | 0/20 |
| lerobot/smolvla_libero (with `--rename_map` camera1/camera2) | 256 | stock `lerobot-eval` | 2/10 | 6/10 | 8/20 |

Fisher exact test, 256 vs 360 on the HuggingFaceVLA checkpoint: p = 0.02. `lerobot/smolvla_libero` was not run at 360 px. The wrapper and stock `lerobot-eval` agree episode for episode at the same settings (256 px, `n_action_steps` 1: 2/20 in both), so the 360 result is not an artifact of the wrapper.

**Expected.** Either the default observation size matches the checkpoint, or loading a policy whose `input_features` image shape differs from the env's rendered shape warns (or the eval script sets the env size from the policy config).

**Suggestion.** Warn in `lerobot-eval` when the env image shape differs from the policy's image `input_features`, and/or note the required `--env.observation_height/width=256` in the SmolVLA LIBERO model cards.

**Reproduce.**
lerobot-eval --policy.path=HuggingFaceVLA/smolvla_libero --env.type=libero --env.task=libero_10 --env.task_ids=[0,4] --eval.batch_size=1 --eval.n_episodes=10 --policy.n_action_steps=10 --seed=1000 [--env.observation_height=256 --env.observation_width=256]
new_candidates.title: LiberoEnv defaults to 360 px observations but the SmolVLA LIBERO checkpoints were trained at 256 px (0/20 vs 6/20 on two LIBERO-10 tasks)
